 ATP Stockholm Best Bets Including Holger Rune Vs Zizou Bergs 
 Share Share this article
 × X Facebook LinkedIn WhatsApp Reddit Email Copy 
 The ATP Stockholm tournament is underway in Sweden. This is an ATP 250 event which is the last tour stop before next week’s ATP Finals in Turin, Italy. The eight spots for Turin have all been decided, so this is just a points-and-money tournament and an opportunity for ATP pros to get in some work before the end of their season. The 2026 ATP Stockholm event is truly a case of last-chance theater. This is what a tournament feels like when it’s the last go-round of a tennis season, and players will compete knowing they will have one and a half months off if not more once their journey in Sweden ends.
 LWOS has our best bets for three matches. Post your best bets and thoughts in the comments.
 ATP Stockholm 
 Arthur Rinderknech – Miomir Kecmanovic: 10:00 EST 
 H2H: 3-1 
 This ATP Stockholm match is a rematch of a 2026 ATP Montreal match won by Arthur Rinderknech over Miomir Kecmanovic, 6-4 in the third set. Will this rematch be as close?
 Best Bet to Make 
 Welcome to our best bet section. You’re going to get a collection of bets to consider, also a confidence level which should guide how much you should invest in this match. Both players are 2-3 in their last five matches, so neither player has a clear edge in current form. 
 Parlay/hedge options: Rinderknech -2 games at 1.65 at @10bet, Kecmanovic +1.5 sets at 1.65 at @interwetten 
 Confidence level on a scale of 1-10: 1 – You should not bet on this match.  
 This ATP Stockholm match feels like a toss-up, even though Rinderknech has been installed as a very clear 1.50 moneyline favorite. These two men have played close, difficult matches in the past. They are also both struggling. Rinderknech is 2-3 in his last five matches. Kecmanovic is 1-4 in his last five. Betting on struggling players is just not smart. We will ultimately go with over 2.5 sets. A three-setter would not be surprising.
 That being said, betting on over 2.5 sets is the best bet you can make 
 Value bet/ the best odds: over 2.5 sets at 2.30 at @betsson 
 Holger Rune – Zizou Bergs: 12:00 EST 
 H2H: 2-0 
 This ATP Stockholm match is notable because it’s Holger Rune’s ninth match of his abbreviated 2026 season. Rune missed the first eight months of the year with an injury. He is 4-4 in the eight matches he played this year. The sportsbooks have him as the clear favorite over Zizou Bergs, who is 2-3 in his last five matches.
 | Source: Lastwordonsports.com - Steen Kirby 
 Best Bet to Make 
 Parlay/hedge options: Rune moneyline at 1.63 at @1xbet 
 Confidence level on a scale of 1-10: 4 – you could bet half a unit on this match. 
 This ATP Stockholm match leans to Bergs, because it’s really hard to trust Holger Rune so soon after his return from injury. Rune is a .500 player. Do you want to trust him to win? Bergs against the game spread makes the most sense here.
 That being said, betting on Bergs +2.5 games is the best bet you can make 
 Value bet/ the best odds: Bergs +2.5 games at 1.76 at @unibet 
 Lorenzo Musetti – Toby Samuel: 13:30 EST 
 H2H: 0-0 
 This ATP Stockholm match offers a simple contrast. Lorenzo Musetti regularly plays the main tour. Toby Samuel frequently plays challenger level events, not tour events. Samuel has won a lot, but against dramatically inferior competition. Musetti is ranked 70 spots higher, 25 to 95.
 Best Bet to Make 
 Parlay/hedge options: Samuel +4.5 games at 1.61 at @1xbet 
 Confidence level on a scale of 1-10: 5 – you could bet three fifths of a unit on this match. 
 This ATP Stockholm match is all about Musetti, who is clearly the better player and whose one-handed strokes should be rewarded by the indoor conditions. There’s no wind or cold weather to disrupt the one-handed Musetti backhand. Take Musetti in straights.
 That being said, betting on Musetti -1.5 sets is the best bet you can make 
 Value bet/ the best odds: Musetti -1.5 sets at 1.82 at @1xbet
